description: Answer a question from the transcripts of one or more videos, or a saved collection, with server-side retrieval and the free-first LLM chain. Every factual sentence cites a numbered source; each source is a timestamp link to the moment that supports it. Says so plainly when the videos do not cover the question. Use it when you want a cited answer without reading whole transcripts.
